I think there are a couple of considerations before we submit this:

- We need the following discussion resolved: https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/libpldm/+/77095/comment/6825587e_8c7b5064/
- I think we might want to add a flags argument to `decode_pldm_firmware_update_package()` to allow future customisation of the parsing behaviour.
Marking as CR-1 for now until the above bits are sorted.
